<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Diagram</title>
  
  <style>
    .title-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; }
    .body-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #334155; }
    .label-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .math-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e3a8a; }
    
    .sq-a {
      animation: pulseA 6s infinite;
    }
    .sq-b {
      animation: pulseB 6s infinite;
    }
    .sq-c {
      animation: pulseC 6s infinite;
    }
    .eq-box {
      animation: highlightEq 6s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulseA {
      0%, 30% { fill: #bfdbfe; stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 3; }
      35%, 65% { fill: #60a5fa; stroke: #2563eb; stroke-width: 4; }
      70%, 100% { fill: #bfdbfe; stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 3; }
    }

    @keyframes pulseB {
      0%, 30% { fill: #bbf7d0; stroke: #22c55e; stroke-width: 3; }
      35%, 65% { fill: #4ade80; stroke: #16a34a; stroke-width: 4; }
      70%, 100% { fill: #bbf7d0; stroke: #22c55e; stroke-width: 3; }
    }

    @keyframes pulseC {
      0% { fill: #fed7aa; stroke: #f97316; stroke-width: 3; }
      35% { fill: #fed7aa; stroke: #f97316; stroke-width: 3; }
      40%, 75% { fill: #fb923c; stroke: #ea580c; stroke-width: 4; }
      80%, 100% { fill: #fed7aa; stroke: #f97316; stroke-width: 3; }
    }

    @keyframes highlightEq {
      0%, 65% { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; }
      70%, 100% { fill: #fef08a; stroke: #eab308; stroke-width: 3; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="title-text">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  
  <!-- ==================== DIAGRAM AREA (Left: 20 to 520) ==================== -->
  
  <!-- 
    Triangle coordinates scaled by 30px per unit:
    Origin of triangle at (180, 360)
    Side b (horizontal, length 4 units) = 120 px -> goes from (180, 360) to (300, 360)
    Side a (vertical, length 3 units)   = 90 px  -> goes from (180, 360) to (180, 270)
    Side c (hypotenuse)                 -> connects (180, 270) to (300, 360)
  -->

  <!-- Squares on sides (drawn first so labels sit clearly on top) -->
  <!-- Square a² (3x3 units = 90x90 px, extending left from vertical side) -->
  <rect x="90" y="270" width="90" height="90" class="sq-a"/>
  
  <!-- Square b² (4x4 units = 120x120 px, extending down from horizontal side) -->
  <rect x="180" y="360" width="120" height="120" class="sq-b"/>

  <!-- Square c² (5x5 units = 150x150 px, constructed outward on the hypotenuse) -->
  <g transform="translate(180, 270)">
    <polygon points="0,0 120,90 210,0 90,-90" class="sq-c"/>
  </g>

  <!-- The Right-Angled Triangle -->
  <polygon points="180,270 300,360 180,360" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="180,342 198,342 198,360" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Square Area Labels (placed safely inside square centres) -->
  <text x="135" y="310" class="label-text">a²</text>
  <text x="135" y="330" class="label-text" font-size="13" fill="#334155">(9)</text>

  <text x="240" y="415" class="label-text">b²</text>
  <text x="240" y="435" class="label-text" font-size="13" fill="#334155">(16)</text>

  <text x="275" y="275" class="label-text">c²</text>
  <text x="275" y="293" class="label-text" font-size="13" fill="#334155">(25)</text>

  <!-- Triangle Side Length & Hypotenuse Labels (shifted into non-overlapping clear spaces) -->
  <text x="135" y="250" class="label-text" font-size="15" fill="#2563eb">a = 3</text>
  <text x="240" y="348" class="label-text" font-size="15" fill="#16a34a">b = 4</text>
  
  <!-- Hypotenuse label placed well clear above-right of the c² square -->
  <text x="350" y="195" class="label-text" fill="#ea580c" font-size="16">hypotenuse</text>
  <text x="350" y="218" class="label-text" font-size="15" fill="#ea580c">c = 5</text>

  <!-- ==================== INFO PANEL AREA (Right: 540 to 780) ==================== -->
  
  <rect x="540" y="80" width="240" height="380" rx="10" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="660" y="115" text-anchor="middle" class="title-text" font-size="18">Key Fact</text>
  
  <!-- Explanatory text -->
  <text x="560" y="150" class="body-text">1. Identify the <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#ea580c">hypotenuse</tspan></text>
  <text x="575" y="172" class="body-text">(longest side, opposite</text>
  <text x="575" y="194" class="body-text">the right angle).</text>
  
  <text x="560" y="235" class="body-text">2. Calculate areas:</text>
  <text x="575" y="257" class="body-text">Area a² = 3 × 3 = 9</text>
  <text x="575" y="279" class="body-text">Area b² = 4 × 4 = 16</text>
  
  <text x="560" y="320" class="body-text">3. Sum equals hypotenuse:</text>
  
  <!-- Highlightable Equation Box -->
  <rect class="eq-box" x="565" y="340" width="190" height="55" rx="6"/>
  <text x="660" y="373" text-anchor="middle" class="math-text">a² + b² = c²</text>
  
  <!-- Numerical substitution -->
  <text x="660" y="425" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#475569" font-size="15">9 + 16 = 25</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <style>
    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { r: 5px; fill: #d97706; }
      50% { r: 8px; fill: #f59e0b; }
    }
    @keyframes trace-circumference {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 628; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes rotate-radius {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    @keyframes dash-flow {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 24; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    .pulsing-centre {
      animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite;
    }
    .circ-path {
      animation: trace-circumference 6s linear infinite;
    }
    .rotating-arm {
      transform-origin: 270px 260px;
      animation: rotate-radius 8s linear infinite;
    }
    .flow-line {
      stroke-dasharray: 6 4;
      animation: dash-flow 1s linear infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="45" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b">Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- ==================== DIAGRAM AREA (x: 20 to 520) ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Circumference background track (faint) -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="260" r="100" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- Diameter (orange, horizontal through centre 270, 260) -->
  <line x1="170" y1="260" x2="370" y2="260" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Animated Radius (purple, rotating from centre to edge) -->
  <g class="rotating-arm">
    <line x1="270" y1="260" x2="370" y2="260" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="370" cy="260" r="5" fill="#8b5cf6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Animated Circumference Trace (teal, tracing the path over time) -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="260" r="100" fill="none" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="628" stroke-dashoffset="628" class="circ-path"/>

  <!-- Centre Dot -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="260" r="6" fill="#0f172a" class="pulsing-centre"/>

  <!-- Diagram Labels with clear spacing -->
  <!-- Centre label -->
  <text x="250" y="245" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#0f172a">centre</text>
  <line x1="258" y1="250" x2="266" y2="256" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Radius label -->
  <text x="320" y="240" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#8b5cf6">radius</text>

  <!-- Diameter label -->
  <text x="270" y="290" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#f97316" text-anchor="middle">diameter</text>

  <!-- Circumference label & pointer -->
  <text x="390" y="175" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#0d9488">circumference</text>
  <path d="M 385 180 Q 365 200 340 215" fill="none" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>


  <!-- ==================== INFO PANEL (x: 540 to 780) ==================== -->
  
  <rect x="540" y="80" width="240" height="380" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="660" y="115" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#334155">Key Definitions</text>

  <!-- Panel Item 1: Centre -->
  <circle cx="570" cy="155" r="5" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="590" y="160" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#0f172a">Centre:</text>
  <text x="590" y="180" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#475569">The exact middle point.</text>

  <!-- Panel Item 2: Radius -->
  <line x1="560" y1="215" x2="585" y2="215" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="595" y="220" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#8b5cf6">Radius:</text>
  <text x="595" y="240" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#475569">Centre to edge.</text>

  <!-- Panel Item 3: Diameter -->
  <line x1="560" y1="275" x2="585" y2="275" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="595" y="280" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#f97316">Diameter:</text>
  <text x="595" y="300" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#475569">Across via centre.</text>
  <!-- Formula highlight box -->
  <rect x="560" y="315" width="200" height="30" rx="6" fill="#ffedd5" stroke="#fdba74" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="660" y="335" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c2410c">diameter = 2 × radius</text>

  <!-- Panel Item 4: Circumference -->
  <circle cx="572" cy="385" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="595" y="390" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#0d9488">Circumference:</text>
  <text x="595" y="410" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#475569">Distance all the</text>
  <text x="595" y="428" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#475569">way around the edge.</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit - GCSE Physics</title>
  
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Main Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="270" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Series Circuit</text>
  <text x="270" y="50" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">GCSE Physics • Current is the same, voltage is shared</text>

  <!-- Key Info Panel (Right Side, x 540-780) -->
  <rect x="540" y="65" width="240" height="405" rx="10" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 540 75 A 10 10 0 0 1 550 65 L 770 65 A 10 10 0 0 1 780 75 L 780 105 L 540 105 Z" fill="#1E293B"/>
  <text x="660" y="90" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">Key GCSE Principles</text>

  <!-- Rule 1: Single Loop -->
  <rect x="550" y="115" width="220" height="80" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="568" cy="135" r="11" fill="#E0F2FE"/>
  <text x="568" y="140" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0369A1" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
  <text x="588" y="140" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A">Single Loop Path</text>
  <text x="562" y="162" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">• Only 1 path for current</text>
  <text x="562" y="180" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">• Circuit forms 1 main loop</text>

  <!-- Rule 2: Current -->
  <rect x="550" y="205" width="220" height="100" rx="8" fill="#FEF3C7" stroke="#FCD34D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="568" cy="225" r="11" fill="#F59E0B"/>
  <text x="568" y="230" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
  <text x="588" y="230" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#92400E">Current is the SAME</text>
  <text x="660" y="254" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#B45309" text-anchor="middle">I₁ = I₂ = 0.2 A</text>
  <text x="562" y="276" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#78350F">• Equal at all points</text>
  <text x="562" y="294" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#78350F">• Same speed everywhere</text>

  <!-- Rule 3: Voltage -->
  <rect x="550" y="315" width="220" height="140" rx="8" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#93C5FD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="568" cy="335" r="11" fill="#2563EB"/>
  <text x="568" y="340" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
  <text x="588" y="340" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E40AF">Voltage is SHARED</text>
  <text x="660" y="364" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1D4ED8" text-anchor="middle">V_total = V₁ + V₂</text>
  <text x="660" y="384" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E3A8A" text-anchor="middle">6 V = 3 V + 3 V</text>
  <text x="562" y="408" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1E40AF">• Cell voltage is divided</text>
  <text x="562" y="426" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1E40AF">• Shared between lamps</text>

  <!-- Circuit Wires -->
  <g stroke="#1E293B" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none">
    <!-- Top Wire Left & Right segments -->
    <line x1="120" y1="130" x2="255" y2="130"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="130" x2="420" y2="130"/>
    <!-- Left Wire Top & Bottom segments -->
    <line x1="120" y1="130" x2="120" y2="260"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="300" x2="120" y2="430"/>
    <!-- Right Wire Top & Bottom segments -->
    <line x1="420" y1="130" x2="420" y2="260"/>
    <line x1="420" y1="300" x2="420" y2="430"/>
    <!-- Bottom Wire segments around Ammeters -->
    <line x1="120" y1="430" x2="177" y2="430"/>
    <line x1="213" y1="430" x2="327" y2="430"/>
    <line x1="363" y1="430" x2="420" y2="430"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Direction Arrows on Wires (Conventional Current: + to -) -->
  <path d="M 190 124 L 180 130 L 190 136" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M 114 195 L 120 205 L 126 195" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M 265 424 L 275 430 L 265 436" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M 414 205 L 420 195 L 426 205" fill="none" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- CELL Symbol (Top Wire, Center at x=270) -->
  <g>
    <!-- Cell Labels outside loop (above top wire) -->
    <text x="270" y="72" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">cell</text>
    <text x="270" y="92" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563EB" text-anchor="middle">voltage = 6 V</text>
    <!-- Plus / Minus symbols -->
    <text x="238" y="122" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="302" y="122" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">−</text>
    <!-- Cell Long line (Positive, left) -->
    <line x1="255" y1="105" x2="255" y2="155" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Cell Short thick line (Negative, right) -->
    <line x1="285" y1="117" x2="285" y2="143" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- LAMP 1 Symbol (Left Wire, Center at 120, 280) -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="120" cy="280" r="20" fill="#FEF08A">
      <animate attributeName="fill" values="#FEF08A;#FDE047;#FEF08A" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="120" cy="280" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="106" y1="266" x2="134" y2="294" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="106" y1="294" x2="134" y2="266" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- Labels outside loop (left of left wire) -->
    <text x="68" y="272" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Lamp 1</text>
    <text x="68" y="292" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563EB" text-anchor="middle">voltage = 3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- LAMP 2 Symbol (Right Wire, Center at 420, 280) -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="420" cy="280" r="20" fill="#FEF08A">
      <animate attributeName="fill" values="#FEF08A;#FDE047;#FEF08A" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="420" cy="280" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="406" y1="266" x2="434" y2="294" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="406" y1="294" x2="434" y2="266" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- Labels outside loop (right of right wire) -->
    <text x="472" y="272" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Lamp 2</text>
    <text x="472" y="292" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563EB" text-anchor="middle">voltage = 3 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- AMMETER 1 Symbol (Bottom Wire, Center at 195, 430) -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="430" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="3"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05); }
      100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); }
    }
    @keyframes flow {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 24; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    .sun-ray {
      transform-origin: 100px 80px;
      animation: pulse 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    .flow-line {
      stroke-dasharray: 6, 6;
      animation: flow 1.5s infinite linear;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Title & Equation -->
  <text x="400" y="35" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b2b2b">Photosynthesis in a Leaf</text>
  <text x="400" y="475" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e7d32">
    carbon dioxide + water → glucose + oxygen
  </text>

  <!-- Sun & Light rays -->
  <g class="sun-ray">
    <circle cx="100" cy="80" r="35" fill="#ffeb3b" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="30" x2="100" y2="15" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="130" x2="100" y2="145" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="80" x2="35" y2="80" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="80" x2="165" y2="80" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="65" y1="45" x2="52" y2="32" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="115" x2="148" y2="128" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="45" x2="148" y2="32" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="65" y1="115" x2="52" y2="128" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="100" y="135" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#d39e00">light</text>

  <!-- Plant / Leaf Structure -->
  <!-- Stem & Roots -->
  <path d="M400,320 Q400,380 390,440" fill="none" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M390,410 Q360,420 330,415" fill="none" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M395,430 Q430,440 460,435" fill="none" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M390,390 Q370,360 340,350" fill="none" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Main Leaf Body -->
  <path d="M400,160 C300,160 250,250 400,320 C550,250 500,160 400,160 Z" fill="#66bb6a" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- Leaf Veins -->

  <path d="M400,210 L330,190" fill="none" stroke="#81c784" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M400,240 L470,220" fill="none" stroke="#81c784" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M400,270 L340,260" fill="none" stroke="#81c784" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M400,290 L460,280" fill="none" stroke="#81c784" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Chlorophyll callout indicator inside leaf -->

  <text x="430" y="244" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffffff">chl</text>

  <!-- ANIMATED ARROWS & LABELS -->

  <!-- 1. Light Energy Arrow (Sun to Leaf) -->
  <line x1="130" y1="100" x2="280" y2="190" stroke="#fbc02d" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="130" y1="100" x2="280" y2="190" stroke="#ffeb3b" stroke-width="4" class="flow-line"/>
  <polygon points="280,190 268,182 272,195" fill="#fbc02d"/>

  <!-- 2. Carbon Dioxide Arrow (Air into Leaf - Left) -->
  <line x1="160" y1="230" x2="310" y2="230" stroke="#78909c" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="160" y1="230" x2="310" y2="230" stroke="#cfd8dc" stroke-width="4" class="flow-line"/>
  <polygon points="310,230 298,223 298,237" fill="#78909c"/>
  <text x="235" y="215" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#37474f">carbon dioxide</text>

  <!-- 3. Oxygen Arrow (Leaf out to Air - Right) -->
  <line x1="490" y1="210" x2="640" y2="210" stroke="#26a69a" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="490" y1="210" x2="640" y2="210" stroke="#80cbc4" stroke-width="4" class="flow-line"/>
  <polygon points="640,210 628,203 628,217" fill="#26a69a"/>
  <text x="565" y="195" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#00695c">oxygen</text>

  <!-- 4. Glucose Arrow (Leaving leaf downwards/sideways) -->
  <line x1="470" y1="290" x2="610" y2="330" stroke="#ab47bc" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="470" y1="290" x2="610" y2="330" stroke="#e1bee7" stroke-width="4" class="flow-line"/>
  <polygon points="610,330 596,328 603,318" fill="#ab47bc"/>
  <text x="560" y="360" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6a1b9a">glucose</text>

  <!-- 5. Water Arrow (Roots up to Leaf) -->
  <line x1="330" y1="360" x2="370" y2="280" stroke="#42a5f5" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="360" x2="370" y2="280" stroke="#bbdefb" stroke-width="4" class="flow-line"/>
  <polygon points="370,280 361,289 369,294" fill="#42a5f5"/>
  <text x="280" y="335" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1565c0">water</text>

  <!-- Chlorophyll separate label box -->
  <rect x="465" y="240" width="115" height="30" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#e8f5e9" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="522.5" y="260" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b5e20">chlorophyll</text>
  <line x1="465" y1="255" x2="445" y2="245" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="1.5"/>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - Solid, Liquid and Gas Particle Arrangement and Motion</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.5; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .caption { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1e3a8a; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #065f46; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f59e0b; stroke: #92400e; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .heading { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Solid vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      25% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      50% { transform: translate(1px, -2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, 2px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    .vib-1 { animation: vibrate 0.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .vib-2 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .vib-3 { animation: vibrate 0.45s infinite ease-in-out; animation-delay: 0.2s; }

    /* Liquid gentle flow */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(5px, -4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-4px, 3px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-6px, 4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(3px, -5px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .liq-1 { animation: flow1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .liq-2 { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas fast movement */
    @keyframes gas-move-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(55px, -45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-35px, -70px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-60px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-65px, 50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(45px, 60px); }
      75% { transform: translate(50px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(40px, 60px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50px, -30px); }
      75% { transform: translate(30px, -50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .gas-1 { animation: gas-move-1 2s infinite linear; }
    .gas-2 { animation: gas-move-2 1.7s infinite linear; }
    .gas-3 { animation: gas-move-3 2.2s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="400" y="38" class="heading">States of Matter & Particle Arrangement</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">solid</text>
    
    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular grid, fixed positions with vibration class) -->
    <g transform="translate(42, 65)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="0" r="11"/>
      
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="0" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="30" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="60" cy="30" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="90" cy="30" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="0" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="30" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="60" cy="60" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="90" cy="60" r="11"/>

      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="90" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="90" cy="90" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Regular arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(287, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">liquid</text>
    
    <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, irregular, sliding past) -->
    <g transform="translate(38, 60)">
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="15" cy="15" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="45" cy="12" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="18" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="105" cy="14" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="25" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="58" cy="42" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="88" cy="48" r="11"/>
      
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="12" cy="78" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="42" cy="72" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="75" cy="75" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="102" cy="78" r="11"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="28" cy="108" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-1" cx="60" cy="105" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid liq-2" cx="90" cy="110" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Close together</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move past each other</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(544, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="225" height="300"/>
    <text x="112" y="35" class="title">gas</text>
    
    <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, fast straight-line movement) -->
    <g transform="translate(112, 130)">
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="-50" cy="-40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="55" cy="-35" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="-40" cy="45" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="45" cy="40" r="11"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="0" cy="-70" r="11"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Motion trails / arrows for gas -->
    <g stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" fill="none">
      <path d="M 60 90 Q 80 70 100 80"/>
      <path d="M 170 80 Q 150 110 130 95"/>
      <path d="M 80 180 Q 100 160 120 175"/>
      <path d="M 160 200 Q 140 180 150 160"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text x="112" y="240" class="caption">Far apart</text>
    <text x="112" y="262" class="caption">Move fast in all directions</text>
    <text x="112" y="284" class="caption">Random arrangement</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer summary box -->
  <rect x="30" y="380" width="740" height="90" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="400" y="410" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">Summary of Particle Model</text>
  <text x="400" y="437" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Particles in all states have energy and move, but the space and freedom of movement</text>
  <text x="400" y="457" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14px" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">change from solid to liquid to gas.</text>

</svg>
